rule.text: A district appears when its share of the city's jobs is at least 1.25× the Swiss share (location quotient) with at least 500 jobs or 1% of the city's jobs, or when one of its specialities has a quotient of 3 or more with at least 300 jobs. Districts are ranked by jobs above the Swiss norm; up to 5. The badge is the strongest district (its speciality's nickname when that has a quotient of 3+), unless a district has a quotient of 6+ and 3%+ of the city's jobs. Jobs from BFS STATENT, at the workplace.
